name: multi-column-directory-list
title: Multi Column Directory List
description: Four-column directory index for organizing extensive rosters of components, tags, or API endpoints.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Directory Index Lookup: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
